title: Beacon index: curated golden sample registry with access controls & versioned bundles
creator: Priya Nair
description: Create a lightweight, queryable "beacon" index that materializes small, curated golden sample bundles used for smoke/regression checks tied to model/config changes. Provide versioning, signer-based immutability, and fine-grained RBAC so stewards can publish approved bundles that automatically trigger fast end-to-end evals when relevant runtime configs or model variants change.
updates: 2025-02-14: Kickoff — scoped MVP: index metadata store (S3 + Dynamo-style index), bundle manifest schema, signer workflow, RBAC controls mapped to existing steward groups. Acceptance criteria agreed with PM: publish + rollback + smoke-run hooks.

2025-02-18: Schema v0.1 defined — fields: bundle_id, semantic_version, created_by, signer_key_id, hash_sha256, sample_count, target_routes, metrics_thresholds, retention_ttl, allowed_groups. Agreed to keep bundle payloads <= 1MB to ensure quick download in CI.

2025-02-22: Proof-of-concept implemented — local beacon index backed by s3://redwood-evals/beacons and a redis index for lookups. End-to-end smoke runner can fetch bundle and run 50-sample eval in ~18s on a small infer host.

2025-02-25: Security review kickoff — DRI (security): Marco Alvarez. Raised requirement: signer keys use existing KMS key policy, signer rotations must be auditable. Added task to integrate HSM-backed signatures for GA.

2025-02-27: PM feedback — expand allowed_groups semantics to include service accounts for CI and a read-only auditor role. Also requested a human-review guard for publishing bundles that change metric thresholds.

2025-03-01: Design review — UX suggestion from Design (Sofia Martinez): expose bundle preview page in Console with diffs between versions and an approval flow. We will implement lightweight preview in MVP; full diffing postponed to Cycle 42.

2025-03-03: Security patch applied to POC: signer verification added to fetch pipeline; failing signature causes 422 and stops deployment triggers. Added unit tests for signature checks and manifest parsing.

2025-03-03: Next steps: harden persistence (replace redis index with dynamo-table), wire the index into config-change webhook to trigger smoke evals, add Datadog dashboard and PagerDuty escalation rule for regression breaches.
